digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler backend abstraction and port layer
propositions: outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py contain literal lazy-load keys to Jira-specific adapters that execute vendor code on neutral paths for any configured backend
comment formatting and truncation must route through a port method (FieldSanitizer.fit_comment) instead of lazy-loading the vendor module directly
inbound ADF-dict normalization must route through a port method (InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text) to preserve defense-in-depth and remain backend-neutral
the literal strings 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira' must be deleted from core modules except inbound_fields.py (the Jira mapper implementation) and verified by a sweep gate test
outbound-comment ADF decode and inbound apply path ADF normalization both use the same InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text backend method to eliminate duplicate vendor code paths
